editionLabel: Looney Labs English Star Trek Chrono-Trek rules
firstPlayerRule: A player whose character has more difficulty pips than every other character goes first. Otherwise, whoever most recently watched a Star Trek episode begins.
officialTieBreak: If nobody has uniquely the most character pips, use the most recent Star Trek episode viewer.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Pips are the difficulty dots beneath a character's name, not the player's experience level.
